scholarship_title: EDISU Piemonte Regional Scholarship and Housing 2026/2027 (first-year students)
provider_organization: EDISU Piemonte (Piedmont Regional Agency for the Right to University Study)
eligible_nationalities: All (students enrolled at Piedmont universities, incl. international students)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Winners who meet merit rules are exempt from or refunded university fees and the regional tax, under each university's fee rules

stipend.notes: Full-time amounts by ISEE band: off-site (fuori sede) EUR 3,800-8,096.78 (female STEM students up to 8,455.33); commuter EUR 1,945.36-4,878.85; in-town EUR 1,295.08-3,318.19; off-site students given an EDISU residence place EUR 1,100-5,755.33. Paid in instalments; second half needs 20 CFU by 10 Aug 2027.

additional_benefits: Place in an EDISU residence (housing service) for eligible off-site students

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: First-year master's: only requirement is enrolling in a Piedmont master's by 30 Nov 2026 (or 2 Apr 2027); merit (20 CFU) needed to keep the grant

required_documents.name: Online application on the EDISU Sportello
required_documents.detail: International students without Italian residence use the 2026/27 Temporary Access Code instead of SPID/CIE

required_documents.name: University ISEE (or equivalent for foreign income)
required_documents.detail: ISEE up to EUR 26,306.25 and ISPE up to EUR 57,187.53, based on 2024 income and assets at 31 Dec 2024

required_documents.name: Paid-accommodation self-declaration
required_documents.detail: Off-site students, to get the off-site amount (lease registered with the Agenzia delle Entrate)

required_documents.name: IBAN of an account in your name

preparation_alerts: Start the ISEE / ISEE parificato paperwork early; it is not issued immediately
Applications close at 12:00 on the deadline day, with no exceptions

selection_criteria.pass_rule: Public competition by income; provisional rankings 21 Oct 2026, definitive 9 Nov and 16 Dec 2026

source_urls.title: EDISU Piemonte: Step by step guide, first-year students 2026/27 (PDF)
source_urls.used_for: Dates, amounts, income limits, access code for international students, rankings, merit rules

verification_status.verification_notes: Read EDISU's official 2026/27 step-by-step guide for first-year students (the guide says the bando prevails). The full bando, including rules for non-EU students' foreign income (ISEE parificato), was not read. Students at Politecnico di Torino and University of Turin apply here.
